DLF Mullanpur — The City Club (2018).

Most wayfinding shouts. The brief here was the opposite: signage for a members' club that does its job without raising its voice. A single warm kraft tone, a fine serif with generous spacing, slim quiet arrows — one calm family from the big directional boards down to the smallest restroom plate.

Pictograms drawn from scratch to match the type, and rooms that carry names with a little heritage — the Viceroy, the Duke, the Cavalry Room — instead of numbers.

Environmental design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·77.
